address: An der Halberstädter Chaussee 1, Magdeburg, 39116, Germany
bio: Since 2003, Sebastian Hadrys has been synonymous with sophisticated cuisine! The food is seasonal and has an international edge. There is a set menu that you can put together yourself by choosing three to seven courses. The prices are very reasonable and the wine list is also very good. As for the setting, the pleasantly bright, modern space has a casual feel, plus a large terrace. Experienced staff provide friendly service. Tip: Cookery courses are also organised here....
